==Airlines and destinations==

===Passenger===

Effective 15 June 2026, [[Etihad Airways]] will offer six daily flights between Ben Gurion and [[Zayed International Airport]] in [[Abu Dhabi]], making it the airlines' most frequently flown route. The AUH-TLV route had 100,000 passengers in the first quarter of 2026, with more than two-thirds using Abu Dhabi as a hub to travel to Etihad destinations elsewhere in Asia.

The following airlines serve regular scheduled and charter destinations at Ben Gurion Airport.
